title: docs: lean decision format for model PR descriptions
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Changed the internal model-PR description guide from a change table to a decision-first format: a Decision line, one Before/After table per model, Verified, and Flags. Each cost cell now states its relation to the price, making cases where price equals primary cost explicit. The RETIRE row remains in place for the news pipeline to parse.
